name: text-report
description: One command that profiles BOTH the vocabulary and grammar of English text against CEFR levels and answers "is this text right for my class?": vocabulary band + grammatical range + a blended estimated level, a --target-level flag that flags what exceeds the class level (words, structures, a coverage figure, and a one-line verdict), and an optional Flesch–Kincaid readability line. Runs the vocab and grammar profilers together. Requires Python 3; the grammar half needs spaCy (the tool degrades gracefully without it).
